body.name: Exact compact-polyhedral overlap with Theorem 4
body.construction: \(\mathcal O_p^{(4)}=\{\mathsf G=(H,\Sigma,\ell,u)\in\mathcal G_p^{\mathrm{cs}}:(H,\Sigma,\ell,u)\text{ is exactly the Gaussian mean domain, covariance, and pair of lower and upper directional-derivative endpoint maps entering the cited Theorem 4}\}\). The cited result is Theorem 4 of \cite{MontielOleaQiuStoye2026Local}.
